verdict.rationale: Raygun supports rule-based triggers for alerting integrations — e.g. PagerDuty incidents created 'when an issue is triggered from this rule' and Slack channel notifications for APM traces — plus 'ignore by rule' conditions for error handling, showing some automated event-to-action capability. However, this is limited to notification/ignore rules rather than a general-purpose automation engine for arbitrary actions on arbitrary events. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader rule/condition engine (e.g. custom triggers, multi-step workflows, webhooks-as-actions beyond third-party integrations), and independent confirmation of reliability.
